meta.message: research: what is METR time horizon metric for AI agents
meta.reply: METR defines the task-completion time horizon as the task duration, measured by human expert completion time, at which an AI agent is predicted to succeed with a given level of reliability [2]. For instance, the 50%-time horizon represents the duration at which an agent is predicted to succeed half the time [2]. This metric is calculated using performance data from over a hundred diverse software tasks [2]. METR has observed that this metric has been consistently exponentially increasing over the past 6 years, with a doubling time of around 7 months [1].
